item.description:
Asobi 1.0 (build 1945) Oct 29, 2026

  • Each review window has its own panels: Playlist, Notes, Comments, Grade and the rest show only their own window's session, sit just above their window, and go with it when it is minimized or closed. With several windows open, a panel's title says whose it is.
  • Choosing more than one option: on a presentation link, clients can choose several options in order of preference and write a note on each. Review Manager ▸ Presentations shows each answer as their first choice, second choice, and so on.
  • Assistants can use every control: through remote control, an AI assistant can now use the whole transport (loops, ping-pong, speed, audio), every color control, the View menu, and draw on the frame (lines, arrows, shapes and text), as well as the other menu commands while Asobi is the front app.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1938) Oct 29, 2026

  • Remote control for AI assistants: Settings ▸ Interface ▸ Remote control lets an assistant (Claude Code, Claude Desktop or any MCP client) work in Asobi on this Mac. It can review, reply to and resolve notes, write reports and movies, conform an updated edit, pull plates and read Kitsu. It never saves a session, and never deletes or replaces a file. Off until you turn it on.
  • Notes to artists: an assistant can group a review's notes by the artists assigned to each shot in Kitsu, and post each task its notes. Posting to Kitsu has its own switch, Let them post to Kitsu, off until you turn it on.
  • Kento through Asobi: with Kento's remote control on, the same assistant reaches Kento's tools too. It can put the shot on screen in a Kento comp as a Read, and bring a Kento render back to review beside the plate.
  • During a live review an assistant can't change the window. The manual's new chapter 16 has the whole list.

1.0 (build 1917) Oct 28, 2026

  • More than one presentation per project: the menu under the Presentation panel's title lists the project's presentations. Switch between them, start a New Presentation, or Duplicate This One for a variation to send separately.
  • Review Manager ▸ Presentations: every presentation made on this Mac, by project, with its link (Copy, Open, the date it runs out) and every answer clients have sent.
  • Making a new link no longer loses the old one: it's listed under Earlier Links, keeps working until it runs out, and its answers are still collected.

1.0 (build 1910) Oct 28, 2026

  • Choosing online: a link made for choosing now shows the layout you picked. Compare is a wipe the client drags across (or moves with the arrow keys), with a choice of what the first picture is set against; Grid shows each option as a card that opens all its pictures; Equal, Featured, Full page and Frames have their own arrangements.
  • The client can take a choice back: Choose again, or Clear choice.
  • Links made before this update keep the earlier layout: make a new link to send the new one.

1.0 (build 1904) Oct 28, 2026

  • Presentations (File ▸ Export ▸ Presentation…): put material in front of a client to decide on, as a PDF in the reports' design. A panel of five steps beside the document itself, drawn live.
  • Material from the playlist or a folder. Movies and sequences give their middle frame, start, middle and end (as one strip or separately), every Nth frame, or the frame on screen; a clip can have its own rule.
  • What is compared with what is yours: pictures start grouped by name, then make a new option from a selection, drag pictures between options, split, merge, take out, tick, rename, reorder.
  • Layouts: Featured, Equal, Grid, Full page, Frames and Compare. Any picture can also have a page of its own. Letter or A4, either orientation, a cover, captions, file names, dark pages, and room for the client's answer.
  • Choosing online: Make a Link for Choosing puts the options on a web page where the client picks one and adds a note. The answer comes back to the panel, marked on the option.
  • The Contact Sheet window's PDF is now the Presentation panel.

1.0 (build 1897) Oct 28, 2026

  • Contact sheet as a PDF: File ▸ Export ▸ Contact Sheet… can write design options as a PDF for a client, in the reports' design. Pictures whose names have the most in common make one option. A cover shows every option side by side, then each option has its page: its main picture large, its variants beside it, with captions you set once.

1.0 (build 1894) Oct 28, 2026

  • Fixed: several folders dropped together added only the last one's pictures. They are now searched together, with one Cancel, and a new drop no longer stops one that is still being added.

1.0 (build 1891) Oct 28, 2026

  • Drop any folder: Asobi searches it, and every folder inside it, for movies, image sequences and single pictures. A folder of stills used to be refused. When a picture is there as an EXR and a PNG, JPEG or TIFF, the display copy plays and the EXR is its source.
  • Cancel: while a folder is searched and added, its progress shows with a Cancel button. Cancelling takes back what it added.
  • Progress and messages now sit under the title strip instead of at the foot of the picture, where the control bar covered them.
  • Fixed: two different pictures in one folder no longer open as a two-frame sequence, and a folder dropped on the Playlist panel is no longer refused.
